baseline_models.focus_anchor: The chain yassarnahu bi-lisanika ... yatadhakkarun links made readiness, the addressee-facing tongue, and renewed mental presence.
baseline_models.mechanism: Divine facilitation opens a low-friction passage into spoken language so that what is absent, forgotten, or unheeded can become present to the hearers again.

activation_trace.role: Ease after difficulty supplies the opening of the passage and its deliberately reduced access cost.
Language and spoken expression supply the human medium through which the opening reaches its audience.
Bringing something back to mind supplies the intended cognitive arrival of the mechanism.
A reminder that restores presence makes the utterance an activator rather than merely an easy object.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely says that the revelation is easy Arabic.
changed_reading.after: The verse describes an engineered passage: revelation is made ready in a hearer-facing tongue so that neglected knowledge can become present again.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Bi-lisanika and yatadhakkarun can join the messenger's articulation to the hearers' later re-utterance.
baseline_models.mechanism: Pliant articulation makes the message mobile: it is conveyed by one tongue, retained, and potentially returned to social circulation as mention on other tongues.

activation_trace.role: Light, compliant movement supplies the message's ability to follow the articulator without drag.
Conveyance by tongue gives the first leg of an oral relay.
Mention carried on the tongue gives remembered content a possible return path into public speech.

changed_reading.before: Remembering is a private mental result of comprehensible wording.
changed_reading.after: Facilitated articulation can begin a relay in which reception becomes retention and retention can become renewed utterance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Yassarnahu can activate the root's apportioning image while bi-lisanika keeps the proposed shares verbal and yatadhakkarun keeps their function mnemonic.
baseline_models.mechanism: An otherwise large whole is apportioned into speakable shares; bounded verbal portions can be voiced, carried, and recombined in memory.

activation_trace.role: Division into allotted shares supplies a strange but concrete model of making a whole distributable.
Spoken expression relocates those shares from a material division into articulated units.
Retention and recall supply the reason that verbal apportionment matters.

changed_reading.before: Ease means only that the whole message is generally uncomplicated.
changed_reading.after: Ease may also concern rhetorical portioning: the whole is made carryable as distinct utterance-sized shares.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context turns generic linguistic ease into a delivery system: what descends is sent, embodied in articulation, heard as understanding and compliance, and faithfully performed as a trust.

activation_trace.role: Ready opening supplies reduced friction at the human end of delivery.
The physical organ of speech locates the conversion from revealed content to audible performance.
Caused descent and arrival supply the incoming movement that needs a human outlet.
Easy, gentle movement makes sending itself a flowing transit rather than a static possession.
Hearing that becomes understanding and compliance supplies the reception endpoint.
Performance of a due right or trust makes oral delivery accountable, not merely fluent.

structural_cues: 44:3-6 moves from descent through sending to hearing, while 44:18 later names entrusted delivery.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies arrival, sending, receptive hearing, and performance of trust; I infer a conversion pipeline through the messenger's articulation. A live alternative is that bi-lisanika only identifies the language and the delivery sequence remains external to 44:58.

changed_reading.before: The revelation has simply been translated into an easy language.
changed_reading.after: Revelation is routed into an accountable spoken performance whose completion is not utterance alone but hearing capable of becoming response.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated differentiation activates the baseline apportionment model: facilitation can consist in separating a dense whole into bounded, clarifying speech-parts without thinning its content.

activation_trace.role: Allotted shares supply the focus-root image of distributable portions.
Spoken language makes those portions rhetorical rather than material.
Recall supplies the mnemonic payoff of bounded speech-parts.
Dispersal into parts activates division as an operation performed on a whole.
A tongue that distinguishes matters through clarification directly joins partition to speech.
Speech-parts that regulate expression supply a formal unitization mechanism.

structural_cues: Differentiation near the opening and the Day of Separation near the close bracket the surah with acts of making boundaries visible.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies division, a clarifying tongue, and regulated speech-parts; I infer that taysir may include rhetorical segmentation. Generic ease remains a materially live alternative because the lots image is branch-distant from the focus form.

changed_reading.before: The whole is made generally easy or is divided into shares only by a speculative focus-root image.
changed_reading.after: The context strengthens a compositional reading: the whole is articulated into distinct, ordered, memorable speech-parts.

context_deltas.mechanism: Facilitation removes access friction but cannot compel uptake: entangled doubt, purposeless play, and active turning-away can interrupt the path from clear reminder to recollection.

activation_trace.role: The opened route defines what has been made available, not what the hearer must choose.
Actual recollection remains the contingent endpoint marked by the final purpose clause.
Interpenetrating alternatives that prevent settled knowledge supply an internal reception blockage.
Action without a sound aim supplies a behavioral diversion from the opened route.
Meaning disclosed by speech or sign establishes that obscurity is not the only explanation for failure.
The already-arrived reminder creates the failed precursor against which the final hope is read.
Turning the back supplies the agentive break between availability and remembering.

structural_cues: 44:13 asks how reminder can operate after a clear messenger has come; 44:14 answers with turning away and hostile labeling.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies clarity, entangling doubt, purposeless diversion, and turning away; I infer that la'allahum preserves a non-coercive affordance. A live alternative is that these scenes concern prior audiences and do not specify the grammar of the final clause.

changed_reading.before: Easy wording should directly cause remembrance.
changed_reading.after: Easy wording removes a communicative obstacle and thereby exposes, rather than overrides, the hearer's capacity to remember or refuse.

context_deltas.mechanism: By reducing linguistic difficulty, the final facilitation calibrates a test: response can reveal the hearer's condition instead of being confounded by inaccessible expression.

activation_trace.role: Reduced difficulty removes one confounding variable from the audience's response.
Shared spoken expression supplies the controlled communicative surface of the assay.
Whether recognition returns becomes the response that can disclose inner condition.
Assaying metal or persons supplies a test that reveals composition under pressure.
Testing that makes a condition appear supplies the diagnostic function of signs.
Truthful speech supplies the explicit criterion challenged by the audience.

structural_cues: The Pharaoh sequence begins with testing, and 44:33 calls the signs an evident trial before the deniers demand proof of truthfulness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assays, revealing tests, signs, and a truth challenge; I infer that accessible language makes response diagnostically legible. A live alternative is that ease is only mercy and the testing frame belongs to the narrated histories.

changed_reading.after: Facilitation also removes the excuse of linguistic inaccessibility, allowing remembrance or refusal to reveal the hearer's stance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opened sea gives a spatial analogue for facilitated language: one accessible passage can carry responsive followers through while exposing pursuing resistance to an opposite outcome.

activation_trace.role: Ease as ready opening anchors the proposed linguistic causeway in the focus verb.
Language supplies the medium through which the open passage is recast rather than copied literally.
Taking the reminder supplies the responsive traversal invited by the passage.
Following behind supplies movement into the same route with opposed orientation.
A broad open gap supplies the concrete passage image that activates focus ease.
Drowning supplies the adverse result of entering the opening as a pursuer.
Rescue by separation supplies the contrasting successful exit.

structural_cues: The night departure, pursuit, deliberately open sea, drowning, and later rescue form one continuous passage sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an open gap, following, drowning, and rescue; I infer a spatial analogy in which verbal ease is an outcome-separating passage. The live alternative is that the sea episode illustrates deliverance but does not qualify taysir semantically.

changed_reading.before: Linguistic ease is a neutral convenience equally consumed by everyone.
changed_reading.after: Linguistic ease is an open route whose availability is shared but whose traversal exposes opposed orientations and outcomes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The denial of being raised activates a scale analogy: speech brings forgotten recognition back into living presence now, a cognitive reanimation that anticipates the bodily reanimation being denied.

activation_trace.role: Recall after forgetting supplies the small-scale return from absence.
Facilitation supplies the means by which dormant recognition can reopen.
Spoken expression is the activating medium of the cognitive return.
Loss of life and force supplies the context's state of terminal absence.
Reviving the dead supplies the larger-scale return explicitly denied by the speakers.

structural_cues: The deniers define death as final in 44:35, while the surah ends by seeking a return of recognition through speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mental recall in the focus and bodily revival in the denial; I infer a scale analogy between renewed recognition and resurrection. A live alternative is that the two returns share only broad rhetoric, not a functional mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Yatadhakkarun means retrieval of stored information.
changed_reading.after: Remembering becomes a present micro-resurrection: facilitated speech attempts to reanimate recognition before the denied greater return occurs.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus root's legal-document image activates inside a book-and-judgment frame: facilitation in the messenger's tongue can be heard as oral service of an already fixed claim before separation and adjudication.

activation_trace.role: A deed or instrument of right supplies the focus-side legal object that must be recalled.
Conveying a message by tongue supplies oral service of that claim.
Ready access makes notice intelligible before enforcement.
An inscription that establishes judgment or decree supplies binding documentary force.
Judgment between people supplies the adjudicative frame.
A fixed, obligatory entitlement supplies the claim's normative content.
Judgment separating right from falsehood supplies the future enforcement horizon.

structural_cues: The clear book and differentiated decrees open the surah; creation in truth and the appointed Day of Separation establish a later adjudicative horizon.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a focus-root deed, binding inscription, fixed right, and judicial separation; I infer that spoken facilitation serves notice before judgment. Ordinary admonition remains the stronger lexical alternative, so this legal reading stays exploratory.

changed_reading.before: The audience is invited to remember an informal admonition.
changed_reading.after: The audience may be receiving intelligible oral notice of a claim already on record, so remembering carries testimonial and juridical weight.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sensory sequence folds the tongue's two domains together: speech now can make consequences experientially present before the later tasting that ends verbal dispute.

activation_trace.role: The bodily tongue anchors the shared oral site of speaking now and tasting later.
Language supplies the anticipatory mode in which absent outcomes can be presented.
Admonitory recall supplies the intended conversion of vivid speech into preventive response.
Taking and tasting food begins the context's oral embodiment of consequence.
Experiencing and undergoing something shifts truth from report to felt verification.
Denial through contentious refusal supplies the speech-state that forced experience terminates.

structural_cues: 44:43-50 renders punishment through eating, boiling, pouring, and tasting; 44:51-57 answers with secure embodied enjoyment immediately before 44:58.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the tongue as organ, tasting as experience, and dispute ended by experience; I infer that facilitated speech offers a merciful verbal pre-tasting. A live alternative is that lisan means language only and the sensory proximity is rhetorical rather than mechanistic.

changed_reading.before: The tongue only translates propositions for intellectual recall.
changed_reading.after: The tongue can make the warned and promised outcomes present in speech as an anticipatory taste, allowing remembrance before compulsory experience.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's opening and closing recast ease as preventive mercy: warning is made accessible so remembrance can become self-protection and passage toward rescue before harm arrives.

activation_trace.role: The opened, ready route supplies mercy's practical availability.
Admonition that restores a matter supplies the protective act invited from hearers.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the preventive orientation of the message.
Tender mercy identifies the sending's governing relation rather than treating warning as bare threat.
Deflecting harm through protection supplies the concrete result toward which recollection can move.
Attaining good and rescue supplies the positive destination immediately preceding the focus.

structural_cues: Warning and mercy are paired near the opening; protection, grace, and rescue stand immediately before the final facilitation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies caution-awakening warning, mercy, protection, and rescue; I infer that linguistic ease is the usable form of preventive mercy. A live alternative is that these are broad themes and 44:58 states only communicative accommodation.

changed_reading.before: Ease is a pedagogical convenience added to the message.
changed_reading.after: Ease is the operational form of mercy: warning is brought within reach so remembrance can become protection before consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The facilitated message enters a contested speech circuit: hearers can revoice clear articulation as false attribution, stone-like verbal attack, counter-translation, or sharp dispute.

activation_trace.role: Conveyance by tongue supplies the initial rendering exposed to reception and rerendering.
Availability explains how the message enters public contest without guaranteeing faithful uptake.
Mention on tongues supplies the social circulation in which hostile revoicing can occur.
Saying what was not so or falsely attributing it supplies the audience's accusatory recoding.
Harmful speech figured as thrown stones joins verbal opposition to the literal threat.
Rendering speech in another tongue supplies the branch-distant image of counter-translation.
Sharp verbal disputation supplies the mature form of resistant revoicing.

structural_cues: The clear messenger is relabeled as taught and mad, then threatened; near the close the audience's prior disputation is recalled.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies false attribution, injurious speech, a translation branch under the stoning form, and sharp dispute; I infer a counter-rendering circuit. Literal stoning remains primary in 44:20, so the translation contribution must remain visibly exploratory.

changed_reading.before: Once made easy in the messenger's tongue, the message travels transparently to memory.
changed_reading.after: Facilitation makes the message available for remembrance but also for hostile re-description; ease governs access, not interpretive custody.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses livestock-yield and milking branches far from ordinary taysir and lisan; it remains anchored because both occur on focus roots and a context sending-root independently contributes repeated milk flow. Render only as a material analogy for elicitation, never as the lexical replacement of the verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Yassarnahu and bi-lisanika converge on productive-yield and milk-elicitation branches, while yatadhakkarun names what is drawn back into presence.

activation_trace.role: Productive increase in milk and offspring recasts facilitation as yield rather than mere reduction.
Using a young camel to induce milk flow supplies a stimulus that draws out what is latent and is then removed.
Repeated milk flow under the sending root gives context-side convergence on productive transmission.
The reminder supplies the elicited return: recognition is drawn out rather than inserted whole.

changed_reading.before: The tongue pours information into passive recipients.
changed_reading.after: The messenger's facilitated tongue may be modeled as an eliciting stimulus that draws latent recognition into active flow.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The fiber-preparation sense is technically remote and should not be presented as an etymology of lisan here; it remains valid as an anchored compositional analogy because the focus supplies that branch and the context independently supplies joining and regulated speech-parts. Downstream prose should mark it as a texture of composition, not a translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus tongue-root can picture loosened fiber made into strands ready for twisting, while ease and recall define the strands' verbal purpose.

activation_trace.role: Prepared fiber strands supply a material model for linguistic elements made ready to combine.
Readiness and ease supply the preparation stage rather than an already finished reception.
Joining one thing to another supplies context-side composition from prepared elements.
Regulated parts of speech supply bounded strands that can be joined without losing distinctions.
Retention and recall supply the functional reason for preparing composable verbal strands.

changed_reading.before: Language is a ready-made container holding an easy message.
changed_reading.after: Language can be imagined as worked material: elements are loosened, bounded, and prepared for memorable recomposition in speech.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the small-amount or short-duration branch of yusr rather than its dominant ease sense; it remains anchored in the focus verb and in the focus verse's placement immediately before reciprocal watching. Render as a temporal undertone only, with ordinary ease kept primary.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Yassarnahu can weakly carry slight duration, while yatadhakkarun names the response sought inside the surah's closing watch.

activation_trace.role: A small amount or brief duration supplies a finite aperture for response.
Recollection supplies the action that may occur before the aperture closes.
An appointed limit supplies the larger temporal boundary.
Reciprocal waiting immediately after the focus turns ease into a present interval under observation.

changed_reading.before: The message possesses timeless, static ease.
changed_reading.after: Alongside ordinary ease, the verse may open a brief usable interval for recollection before the mutually watched outcome arrives.

strongest_changes: The focus moved from a language label to an audible, entrusted delivery system whose endpoint is responsive hearing.
Repeated differentiation strengthened a surprising account of ease as ordered rhetorical portioning rather than dilution.
Doubt, play, and turning away made facilitation an affordance and an assay, not a mechanism of compelled belief.
The sensory close made the speaking tongue a medium of merciful pre-tasting before consequences become compulsory experience.
Warning, mercy, protection, and rescue reframed accessibility as preventive action rather than pedagogical convenience alone.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's three roots supported several coexisting mechanisms: passage, relay, segmentation, diagnostic exposure, protective warning, embodied anticipation, and more distant legal, resurrection, fiber, and productive-yield analogies. Context repeatedly changed what ease does without requiring one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The lots, legal-deed, fiber, milk-elicitation, short-duration, and counter-translation branches are packet-grounded but form-distant, so their explanatory yield may exceed their lexical force.
The tongue-to-taste bridge may be a deliberate embodied mechanism or only a strong adjacency created by the closing sensory sequence.
The sea-passage and micro-resurrection readings may describe surah-level structural analogies rather than semantic content carried by yassarnahu or yatadhakkarun themselves.
